items.name: Moss Mother
items.how: The first boss. Cut the two vines at the entrance to reach it. Beating it opens the way up out of Moss Grotto. It drops nothing, so it is a Task.

items.name: Silkspear
items.how: A Silk Skill, and a permanent one. You reach Mosshome later, through The Marrow, which comes after Moss Mother.
